meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以调用 agent-browser 自动操作浏览器:打开网页、点击/填写表单、截图、录屏、提取数据、测试网页应用。操作时通过快照返回的元素编号(如 @e1)定位页面元素,还能模拟键盘鼠标、管理标签页等。
howto.when: 当你说要打开或浏览网站、填写网页表单、截图等网页相关操作时,Claude 就会调用它来操控浏览器。

say.text: 打开 example.com,帮我截一张整页截图
say.note: 会执行 open 和 screenshot --full

say.text: 在登录表单里填上测试账号并提交
say.note: 会按快照编号填表并点击提交

say.text: 把这个按钮滚动到可见位置再点击它

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use agent-browser to automate a real browser: open pages, click or fill forms, take screenshots, record video, extract data, and test web apps. It locates elements by refs (like @e1) from snapshots, and can simulate keyboard/mouse, manage tabs, etc.
howto.when_en: It activates when you ask to open or browse a website, fill a web form, take a screenshot, or do other browser-related tasks.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a full-page screenshot
Fill in the login form with test credentials and submit
say_en.note: Fills fields by ref and clicks submit

say_en.text: Scroll the button into view and click it
